confirm.description: Add the scale {name}? Readings arrive passively from its advertisements; nothing ever connects to it.

user.title: Add a BLE scale
user.description: Pick a scale that is advertising right now, or leave this and enter an address by hand.

manual.title: Enter the scale's address
manual.description: These scales sleep between weigh-ins and only advertise while someone is standing on them, so nothing may be listed. Enter the Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF) to set it up now; entities stay unavailable until the first reading arrives.

person.title: Who uses this scale?
person.description:
Height, age and sex are what turn a weight into body composition — without a person configured, only weight and impedance are reported. Each person also gets a “weighing in” button to claim the next reading.

People added so far: {count}. Scale currently reads: {seen}.

error.invalid_address: That is not a Bluetooth address. Expected six hex pairs, like A0:91:61:C8:0B:5D.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up.
abort.not_supported: That device uses the same Bluetooth service as a supported scale, but its readings are in a format this integration does not decode.
